paragraphs.text:
If you approached Blake or Rambeau, they are aware of a threat 
to the world. They use their influence to allow you to accompany 
a party. But which one? Go to 520. 
If you approached anyone else, you are back in confinement 
aboard The Dark Sea. After the parties leave, you go to 574.
(528, 530)
